key_points: STX sold off ~5.5% on Nov 16 as part of broad memory/storage sector decline ahead of Nvidia earnings, not company-specific news
Druckenmiller 13F showing increased stake is backward-looking (Sept 30 data) and already priced
No earnings surprise, guidance change, regulatory action, M&A, or major product news for Seagate
Selloff appears driven by sector risk-off / Nvidia earnings anxiety rather than STX fundamentals
Headlines largely noise: comparison pieces, generic market wraps, stale 13F data
